svg.title: Scoring analysis records outside the cluster
svg.desc: Overview of ADR-0047. The analyzer of the www cluster, which we do not run, creates a record in its records container. Blob created goes through an Event Grid system topic to a storage queue. A Container Apps job that scales to zero takes one message per execution. It checks the size and the schema, runs the redactor again and quarantines the record on any hit before any model call, ends without a model call when the record is already scored or the month's cap is reached, then makes one judge call from the other model family than the analysis, with allowlisted fields, a fixed prompt, a fixed answer schema and one tool, a cross-check by a second model asked at most once. It creates the score and deletes the message. The job runs in the intake's own small virtual network and reaches the records account through a storage service endpoint. Before each model call it creates a spend reservation. Anthropic through workload identity federation if the account accepts it, otherwise a capped key; OpenAI a capped key; each capped at 40 to 50 USD a month in its provider's console and in code, paid from the providers' allowances, not Azure credits. Scores, reservations and quarantined records are in the intake's own containers with a retention period. One managed identity reads records, reads and creates scores, writes quarantine, processes one queue and reads the Key Vault secrets. It has no storage key and no cluster credential.
svg.text: not run by us; creates a record
sends the event to the queue
at least once; a message is deleted
only after the score is written
CONTAINER APPS JOB IN ITS OWN VNET, SCALES TO ZERO, ONE MESSAGE PER RUN, NO INGRESS
1 Name and size: bad ID or over 1 MiB, quarantine, not downloaded
2 Schema: known fields and version only; otherwise quarantine
3 Redactor Clean on every string and key; any hit quarantines the record
4 Already scored (ID and hash) or month cap reached: no model call
5 Reserve the run's tokens, then one judge call: allowlisted fields,
fixed prompt and schema, one tool (cross_check, once, counted in code).
6 Create the score (create-only), then delete the message; a failed read retries.
Cap refused: budget entry. Retries spent: error entry. Neither is a score.
each capped 40 to 50 USD a month,
read the records container; read and create scores and reservations; write quarantine (no read); process one queue;
read the Key Vault secrets (keys only where federation is refused), each at its own scope; custom roles, no delete.
a storage key, a write or delete on records, a cluster or Git credential, a role assignment right, any use of a score to decide an action.
